# `company.presence`

Short-lived advisory records showing who is editing a company record.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `record_type` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable type name of the record being edited. |
| `record_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Identifier of the record being edited. |
| `user_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 3 | — | — | User id whose editor reports this presence. |
| `interface` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | primary key 4 | — | — | Interface from which this presence is reported. |
| `started_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this editing session first reported presence. |
| `heartbeat_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the most recent presence heartbeat. |
